audience: e-commerce teams that run a Ticimax online store and handle its orders and stock

useCases.title: Find paid orders not yet shipped
useCases.text: List orders by status and payment status, newest first. Read the order status names first to choose the right status.

useCases.title: Check the shipments of an order
useCases.text: Read one order with its shipping details, then list its packages with carrier, tracking number and link.

useCases.title: Check stock and price by barcode
useCases.text: Look up a variant by barcode or stock code, and read its stock quantity, price and discounted price.

useCases.title: Count products that match a filter
useCases.text: Count the products that match a stock level, category, brand or date filter, then list the matching product cards.

useCases.title: Move an order to shipped
useCases.text: Set an order to the shipped status with its tracking number and link. Ticimax runs its usual steps, and the customer gets an e-mail only if you ask for one.

useCases.title: Record an invoice number on an order
useCases.text: Record the invoice number of an order. A new number replaces the previous one.
